gate_changes_reviewed: A second independent pre-adoption MECHANISM Discovery exposed a terminal-relevant public-API accessor mismatch only after an outcome-bearing path had run, then repaired the same object.
Control Brain subsequently adopted a prospective terminal/API semantic preflight tightening without changing scientific success, novelty, comparator, reduction, or readiness thresholds.
Control refused to ratify the repaired fresh SUB object as prospectively clean science and preferred explicit HOLD_METHOD_LIMITED pending Analyst review.
MAIN fail-closed because the newer SUB generation had not yet been consumed by a newer Evidence Analyst generation and therefore did not canonicalize the pending object or recompute funnel metrics.
No new external Literature/Audit result justifies a universal numeric threshold or broader scientific gate tightening.
false_positive_risks: Until producer-side preflight is demonstrated after adoption, an unexpected terminal-relevant representation can still be normalized after outcome exposure and mistakenly treated as a prospectively clean same-object result.
A repaired same-object run could acquire promotion/readiness credit if downstream containment is bypassed; current Control and MAIN behavior mitigates this.
Pending unreviewed candidates could distort funnel conversion statistics if included before Evidence Analyst classification; current MAIN correctly excludes the new SUB object.
A future SYSTEM priority exception could be justified post hoc unless recorded prospectively; no live use exists.
false_negative_risks: A method-limited object must not be interpreted as scientific falsity solely because its harness was malformed; fresh confirmation should be used only when the question remains worth the opportunity cost.

Requiring fresh objects for every harmless formatting issue could waste throughput; the fresh-object requirement should attach to outcome-exposed terminal-relevant semantic repairs that materially affect scientific disposition or allocation.
READY could still become a hidden second Formal gate if it later requires prior comparator/reduction/falsifier success; no READY case exists yet.
Mechanism priority must continue to preserve high-information SYSTEM work; no new starvation evidence exists.

moving_goalpost_assessment.finding: Two independent pre-adoption lower-funnel objects changed terminal-relevant operationalization after outcome exposure. Neither history was rewritten and the new Control rule now explicitly withholds clean closure/promotion/readiness from such repaired same-object runs. The remaining question is whether producer-side preflight prevents recurrence on a fresh post-adoption object.

pass_reachability_assessment.finding: Prospective MECHANISM objects have repeatedly occupied preformal_eligible=true while NOT_READY, so admissibility does not require prior success. No READY candidate exists. Terminal/API preflight is an integrity constraint, not an added success threshold.

claim_type_separation_findings: Healthy. The fresh pending object was prospectively MECHANISM and is not being rescued into SYSTEM. Control's preferred HOLD_METHOD_LIMITED marks a method limitation rather than converting it into a clean scientific negative. Existing SYSTEM architecture/testbed/reproducibility value remains preserved.

mechanism_supply_health.finding: The pending theory-backward object is genuinely mechanism-level and falsifiable. It is not canonicalized before Analyst review, and the one-in-three rule remains a floor rather than a target.

funnel_observability.finding: Evidence Analyst R16 remains the authority for 11 fully classified candidates. MAIN detected the newer SUB dependency and blocked rather than silently importing the proposed classification or recomputing metrics.

preformal_gate_calibration.finding: Existing prospective true/NOT_READY examples show eligibility is not prior success. The first READY-to-PRE_FORMAL transition is still unobserved.

system_priority_exception_audit.finding: MAIN performed no SYSTEM-over-comparable-MECHANISM execution and used no exception; it blocked on stale Analyst authority.

no_coherent_target_audit.finding: No NO_COHERENT_MECHANISM_TARGET exception has been used. First-use calibration remains unobserved.

classification_completeness.policy_use: Canonical funnel policy remains based on the complete Analyst-reviewed 11/11 population. The newer SUB object is explicitly excluded until fresh Analyst classification; raw conversion rates remain descriptive and do not define universal thresholds.

prospective_recommendations: Keep the prospective terminal/API semantic preflight tightening; do not tighten admission, novelty, comparator, reduction, or readiness success thresholds.
Treat the fresh presemantic-function-transfer repair as a pre-adoption calibration case, not evidence that the newly adopted rule failed.
Retain explicit outcome-exposed repair lineage and withhold clean same-object closure, promotion, or readiness when terminal semantics were repaired after outcome exposure.
When scientific disposition materially depends on such a repair and the question remains worthwhile, require a fresh correctly bound object rather than rerunning/rescuing the current object.
Keep MAIN dependency-aware fail-closed behavior and classification-completeness gating.
Audit the first fresh post-adoption outcome-bearing object for actual producer-side preflight compliance.
Continue auditing the first READY-to-PRE_FORMAL transition, first SYSTEM-priority exception, and first NO_COHERENT_MECHANISM_TARGET use.

hard_integrity_floor_confirmation.finding: All recommendations strengthen prospective semantic binding and preserve no rerun/retune of consumed identities, frozen/prospective protocol, raw-before-score, preserve-before-read, exact bindings, immutable evidence, leakage prevention and no silent post-outcome repair.

Does fresh Analyst classify the presemantic-function-transfer object as method-limited rather than granting clean REJECT/promotion/readiness credit from the repaired same-object run?
At the first READY object, is READY granted because the next PRE_FORMAL test is prospectively well-defined and informative rather than because comparator/reduction/falsifier were already won?
At the first MAIN SYSTEM-over-comparable-MECHANISM allocation, is system_priority_exception persisted before execution?
At the first NO_COHERENT_MECHANISM_TARGET use, is the quality-floor failure recorded without manufacturing a filler MECHANISM candidate?
